package.name: data_collection
package.description: Quest-driven VR teleop and data collection tools for MoveIt Pro. Consumes the oculus_reader Python module to stream Meta Quest controller poses, publishes them (and clutched reference frames) as TF, drives the robot via /velocity_force_controller/command, and commands the Robotiq gripper via the /robotiq_gripper_controller/gripper_cmd action.
